title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Amara 's Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) light novel revealed additional cast, a second key visual (pictured), and promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere on Tokyo MX, BS NTV, and Yomiuri TV in July 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime Reveals New Promo Video, More Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels revealed its second "pick-up" promotional video, key visual, and three new cast members on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ran Kuze 's Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai ( Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms ) manga revealed new staff, teaser visual (pictured) and promotional video for its second season on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Mebius Dust' Reveals Main Cast, Opening Theme, First Episode Promo, Summer 2026 Premiere
content: The official website for the Mebius Dust television anime revealed the main cast, opening theme, and promotional video for the first episode on Thursday. The anime will premiere in July 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World TV Anime Reveals Trailer, Ending Theme Song, More Cast, Key Visual
content: The staff for the television anime of Yoneori 's The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World ( Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car o Shōkan Shimashita ) light novel series announced on Thursday a trailer, the ending theme song artist, more cast members, and a key visual.
author: ANN

title: Mebius Dust TV Anime Unveils 1st Episode Preview, Main Cast Members, Opening Song Artist, July Debut
content: ASMIK Ace revealed on Thursday the first episode preview, main cast members, and July premiere of Dōga Kōbō 's original television anime Mebius Dust , based on Hajime Shinagawa 's story of the same title, which won the grand prize for the "Kids/Game" category of the Project Anima competition in 2019.
author: ANN

title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Yotsuba Succession Arc Film Debuts at #5, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Drops to #2
content: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination, and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — dropped from #1 to #2 in its third weekend. The film sold 341,000 tickets and earned 490,061,280 yen (about US$3.10 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: HIDIVE Acquires The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World Anime for Summer 2026
content: AMC Global Media’s anime streaming service HIDIVE has announced that the new adaptation The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World will debut in July as part of its Summer 2026 simulcast season.
author: Anime Corner

title: Agents of the Four Seasons Releases Episode 8 Preview
content: Agents of the Four Seasons released the preview of Episode 8 on Wednesday. It is scheduled to premiere on Saturday, May 16. Wit Studio is animating the series with Ken Yamamoto as director. Ayumu Hisao is handling the script, Namiko Torii is designing the characters, and Kensuke Ushio is composing the music.
author: Anime Corner
